duplicate.title: Entity duplication

info.title: About duplication
info.validation: In the duplicated entity, the internal validation of flows (blocks back to drafting) and the external validation of documents (back to PREL) start over.
info.otherDocuments: Other documents (lists, form documents, closing folder…) are not recreated.
info.library: Documents imported from the library keep their state.
info.signatures: Signatures and form responses are not copied.
info.collaborators: Collaborators are not copied: you become the Manager of the new entity.
info.template: A Template entity only hosts template flows: group flows are skipped and no document is copied.

duplicate.inProgress: Duplication in progress, running in the background
duplicate.inProgressDescription: The new entity will appear in the list once processing is over (follow it in the events bell).
